Operator, is a quintessential and slightly misunderstood piece of trading literature. This 1923 classic is a slightly fictionalized biography of Jesse Livermore written by Edward, Lefevre. Livermore, often celebrated as a genius and as 1 of the great, speculators of all time went bankrupt, 3 times and eventually Committed suicide in the cloak room of the Sherry Netherland Hotel in New York City.
